answer.reason: The verses tell of Uriah's refusal to go home and of his death at David's order, which are the chief events of his story.

clauses.english: refused to go down to his house while the ark and the army camped in tents
clauses.quote: shall I then go into mine house, to eat and to drink, and to lie with my wife?

clauses.english: was set in the hottest battle at David's command and died before Rabbah
clauses.quote: Set ye Uriah in the forefront of the hottest battle

doubts: MAT 1:6 names 'Urias', the wife's husband, only as a relation, so it was left out.
2SA 11:21 names Abimelech, not Uriah, in its first part; only the last words concern Uriah.
